name: pax8-mcp
description: Every Pax8 Partner API endpoint, plus an offline store that reconciles billing, tracks MRR, and catches usage overages no Pax8 tool surfaces.

pax8_client_id.title: PAX8_CLIENT_ID
pax8_client_id.description: Sets PAX8_CLIENT_ID for the Pax8 MCP server.

pax8_client_secret.title: PAX8_CLIENT_SECRET
pax8_client_secret.description: Sets PAX8_CLIENT_SECRET for the Pax8 MCP server.

pax8_oauth_scope.title: PAX8_OAUTH_SCOPE
pax8_oauth_scope.description: Sets PAX8_OAUTH_SCOPE for the Pax8 MCP server. Required by the generated client for credential refresh or hand-written auth flow.

pax8_audience.title: OAuth audience
pax8_audience.description: OAuth2 audience claim requested when minting the Pax8 token. The default is the partner API audience; change it only if Pax8 told you to.

pax8_base_url.title: Pax8 API base URL
pax8_base_url.description: Base URL for the Pax8 API. Leave the prefilled default unless your account uses a different regional or self-hosted host.

pax8_token_url.title: OAuth2 token URL
pax8_token_url.description: Token endpoint the client-credentials exchange posts to. Leave the prefilled default unless your tenant uses a different token endpoint.
